def compile_mjcf(facts, out):
    links = ['base_frame','base_bolt_1','base_bolt_2','base_bolt_3','base_bolt_4','yaw_pin','yaw_thrust_bearing','yaw_carriage','shoulder_pin','shoulder_link','elbow_pin','elbow_link','wrist_pin','wrist_link','end_effector_pointer']
    cmap = {'base_frame':None,'base_bolt_1':None,'base_bolt_2':None,'base_bolt_3':None,'base_bolt_4':None,'yaw_pin':None,'yaw_thrust_bearing':None,'yaw_carriage':'base_yaw_revolute','shoulder_pin':'base_yaw_revolute','shoulder_link':'shoulder_pitch_revolute','elbow_pin':'shoulder_pitch_revolute','elbow_link':'elbow_pitch_revolute','wrist_pin':'elbow_pitch_revolute','wrist_link':'wrist_pitch_revolute','end_effector_pointer':'wrist_pitch_revolute'}
    contacts = [
      {'pair':['base_frame','yaw_pin'],'action':'exclude','reason':'measured interference press fit rigidly fixes the yaw pin in the base','source_entity_ids':['port/base_frame/yaw_axis','port/yaw_pin/yaw_shaft'],'fact_ids':['fit/base_frame/yaw_axis/yaw_pin/yaw_shaft','pair/base_frame/yaw_pin']},
      {'pair':['yaw_carriage','yaw_pin'],'action':'exclude','reason':'measured clearance running fit is represented by the yaw hinge','source_entity_ids':['port/yaw_carriage/yaw_bore','port/yaw_pin/yaw_shaft','motion_joint/base_yaw_revolute'],'fact_ids':['fit/yaw_pin/yaw_shaft/yaw_carriage/yaw_bore','pair/yaw_carriage/yaw_pin','nearby/yaw_carriage/yaw_pin']},
      {'pair':['yaw_carriage','yaw_thrust_bearing'],'action':'exclude','reason':'thrust bearing running interface is represented by the yaw hinge','source_entity_ids':['link/yaw_thrust_bearing','motion_joint/base_yaw_revolute'],'fact_ids':['pair/yaw_carriage/yaw_thrust_bearing','nearby/yaw_carriage/yaw_thrust_bearing']},
      {'pair':['yaw_carriage','shoulder_pin'],'action':'exclude','reason':'dedicated shoulder pin is rigidly carried by the carriage clevis','source_entity_ids':['port/yaw_carriage/shoulder_clevis','port/shoulder_pin/shaft'],'fact_ids':['fit/yaw_carriage/shoulder_clevis/shoulder_pin/shaft','pair/shoulder_pin/yaw_carriage','nearby/shoulder_pin/yaw_carriage']},
      {'pair':['yaw_carriage','shoulder_link'],'action':'keep','reason':'adjacent independently rotating structural links may have real collision; overlap measurement is uncertain','source_entity_ids':['motion_joint/shoulder_pitch_revolute'],'fact_ids':['pair/shoulder_link/yaw_carriage','nearby/shoulder_link/yaw_carriage']},
      {'pair':['base_frame','yaw_carriage'],'action':'exclude','reason':'positive mesh separation and disjoint AABB extent make proxy false contact a risk','source_entity_ids':['motion_joint/base_yaw_revolute'],'fact_ids':['pair/base_frame/yaw_carriage','nearby/base_frame/yaw_carriage']},
      {'pair':['base_bolt_1','yaw_carriage'],'action':'exclude','reason':'disjoint solids with positive separation have no contact function','source_entity_ids':['link/base_bolt_1','motion_joint/base_yaw_revolute'],'fact_ids':['pair/base_bolt_1/yaw_carriage','nearby/base_bolt_1/yaw_carriage']},
      {'pair':['base_bolt_2','yaw_carriage'],'action':'exclude','reason':'disjoint solids with positive separation have no contact function','source_entity_ids':['link/base_bolt_2','motion_joint/base_yaw_revolute'],'fact_ids':['pair/base_bolt_2/yaw_carriage','nearby/base_bolt_2/yaw_carriage']},
      {'pair':['base_bolt_3','yaw_carriage'],'action':'exclude','reason':'disjoint solids with positive separation have no contact function','source_entity_ids':['link/base_bolt_3','motion_joint/base_yaw_revolute'],'fact_ids':['pair/base_bolt_3/yaw_carriage','nearby/base_bolt_3/yaw_carriage']},

      {'pair':['base_bolt_3','shoulder_link'],'action':'exclude','reason':'positive separation and disjoint AABB extents show no contact function','source_entity_ids':['link/base_bolt_3','link/shoulder_link'],'fact_ids':['pair/base_bolt_3/shoulder_link','nearby/base_bolt_3/shoulder_link']},
      {'pair':['base_bolt_4','shoulder_link'],'action':'exclude','reason':'positive separation and disjoint AABB extents show no contact function','source_entity_ids':['link/base_bolt_4','link/shoulder_link'],'fact_ids':['pair/base_bolt_4/shoulder_link','nearby/base_bolt_4/shoulder_link']},
      {'pair':['shoulder_link','wrist_pin'],'action':'exclude','reason':'positive separation and disjoint AABB extent show no contact function','source_entity_ids':['link/shoulder_link','link/wrist_pin'],'fact_ids':['pair/shoulder_link/wrist_pin','nearby/shoulder_link/wrist_pin']},
      {'pair':['base_frame','shoulder_link'],'action':'exclude','reason':'positive separation and disjoint AABB extent show no contact function','source_entity_ids':['link/base_frame','link/shoulder_link'],'fact_ids':['pair/base_frame/shoulder_link','nearby/base_frame/shoulder_link']},
      {'pair':['elbow_link','elbow_pin'],'action':'exclude','reason':'measured clearance running fit is represented by the elbow hinge','source_entity_ids':['port/elbow_link/elbow_eye','port/elbow_pin/shaft','motion_joint/elbow_pitch_revolute'],'fact_ids':['fit/elbow_pin/shaft/elbow_link/elbow_eye','pair/elbow_link/elbow_pin','nearby/elbow_link/elbow_pin']},
      {'pair':['elbow_link','wrist_pin'],'action':'exclude','reason':'dedicated wrist pin is rigidly carried by the elbow clevis','source_entity_ids':['port/elbow_link/wrist_clevis','port/wrist_pin/shaft'],'fact_ids':['fit/elbow_link/wrist_clevis/wrist_pin/shaft','pair/elbow_link/wrist_pin','nearby/elbow_link/wrist_pin']},
      {'pair':['elbow_link','wrist_link'],'action':'keep','reason':'adjacent independently rotating structural links may collide; solid overlap is uncertain','source_entity_ids':['motion_joint/wrist_pitch_revolute'],'fact_ids':['pair/elbow_link/wrist_link','nearby/elbow_link/wrist_link']},
      {'pair':['elbow_link','end_effector_pointer'],'action':'exclude','reason':'positive separation and disjoint AABB extent show no contact function','source_entity_ids':['link/elbow_link','link/end_effector_pointer'],'fact_ids':['pair/elbow_link/end_effector_pointer','nearby/elbow_link/end_effector_pointer']},
      {'pair':['wrist_link','wrist_pin'],'action':'exclude','reason':'measured clearance running fit is represented by the wrist hinge','source_entity_ids':['port/wrist_link/wrist_eye','port/wrist_pin/shaft','motion_joint/wrist_pitch_revolute'],'fact_ids':['fit/wrist_pin/shaft/wrist_link/wrist_eye','pair/wrist_link/wrist_pin','nearby/wrist_link/wrist_pin']},
      {'pair':['wrist_link','end_effector_pointer'],'action':'exclude','reason':'tool mounting faces are coincident and the pointer is rigidly carried by the wrist','source_entity_ids':['port/wrist_link/tool_mount','port/end_effector_pointer/mount_face'],'fact_ids':['fit/wrist_link/tool_mount/end_effector_pointer/mount_face','pair/end_effector_pointer/wrist_link','nearby/end_effector_pointer/wrist_link']}
    ]
    plan = {'coordinate_map':cmap,'tree_edges':[['base_frame','yaw_carriage','base_yaw_revolute'],['yaw_carriage','shoulder_link','shoulder_pitch_revolute'],['shoulder_link','elbow_link','elbow_pitch_revolute'],['elbow_link','wrist_link','wrist_pitch_revolute']], 'closure_edges':[], 'rigid_carried':[['base_frame','base_bolt_1'],['base_frame','base_bolt_2'],['base_frame','base_bolt_3'],['base_frame','base_bolt_4'],['base_frame','yaw_pin'],['base_frame','yaw_thrust_bearing'],['yaw_carriage','shoulder_pin'],['shoulder_link','elbow_pin'],['elbow_link','wrist_pin'],['wrist_link','end_effector_pointer']], 'independent_coaxial':[['yaw_pin','yaw_carriage'],['shoulder_pin','shoulder_link'],['elbow_pin','elbow_link'],['wrist_pin','wrist_link']], 'transmissions':[], 'contact_decisions':contacts, 'support_ground':['base_frame'], 'support_strategy':'fixed base_frame rests on the global ground; no support-probe patch is required'}

    for e in ids:
